description.purpose: GH #921: two webhook mounts on the colony's one listener, one proven by an HMAC over the raw body and one by a token header, both emitting onto a lane that ends in a sink, and a sink for their receipts.
description.use_when: As the tree of the webhook proof; the test writes the two secrets into .env.
description.not_in_scope: No model, no wall clock, no answer to the sender beyond the status code.
examples: a signed POST to /probe-hook/ arrives once under /sink with hop.route 'probe'
an unsigned POST is answered 401 and booked under /receipts as webhook_unverified
